newsitem.title: UK: Ladbroke down as Hoare downgrades to "hold".
newsitem.headline: Ladbroke down as Hoare downgrades to "hold".

text.p: Shares in Ladbroke Group Plc fell on Thursday after analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett cut the stock to "hold" from "buy" even as they raised their forecasts for the company's 1997 profits.
By 0931 GMT Ladbroke was down 5-1/2p at 226-1/2. It was the heaviest traded share in London with volume at 7.25 million.
Hoare Govett analyst Andrew Hunter declined comment on reasons for the downgrade.

He said he had raised his forecast for 1997 pre-tax profits by 21 million pounds after Monday's announcement that 49's Limited, in which Ladbrokes has an interest, was not deemed an illegal lottery by the Crown Prosecution Service.
Hoare Govett's previous forecast for 1997 profits had been 184.0 million pounds, according to the Estimate Directory.
UK lottery operator Camelot LOTT.CN had asked for clarification of the legal status of the 49's betting game in December.
